messages:
mike_support: customer ACCT-1123 reporting sudden p99 spikes and EU billing hits. they say they set X-Client-Region: eu but traces show requests routed to us-east-1. can someone take a look?

mike_support: sample headers we received (redacted):
```
:method: POST
:authority: api.redwood.com
:x-client-region: eu
:cookie: session=abcd; region=
:user-agent: curl/7.79.1
```

ryan_devx: quick q — is there a proxy/CDN in front of them? any chance a cookie is being injected/rewritten?

mike_support: yes they go through partner-cdn/edge. they said they only set the header in app code. cookie shown above came from the browser via the CDN (they're a web app).

anya_sre: I pulled router logs for trace id trace-9f3b and timestamp 4387654325: routing decision metadata shows chosen_region = us-east-1 and routing_reason = cookie_precedence. router currently prefers cookie 'region' over header when present. it treats empty string as explicit value.

ingrid_ops: that matches an old LB redirect behavior we saw — some CDNs add a blank 'region' cookie when doing sticky redirects. basically they append 'region=' which makes the cookie exist but empty.

mike_support: customer reports clearing cookies made calls route to eu correctly. temporary mitigation worked for them.

ryan_devx: sounds like a precedence/validation bug. router should ignore empty values and treat them as absent. i'll open an eng-runtime ticket and add repro steps.

mike_support: repro for you:
```bash
# routes to eu
curl -H "X-Client-Region: eu" -H "Cookie:" -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate

# routes to us-east if empty cookie present
curl -H "X-Client-Region: eu" -H "Cookie: region=" -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```

anya_sre: thanks, that nail it for me. i'll change router config to treat blank cookie values as missing and push a canary. will also add a short-circuit so if header explicitly present we honor it over empty cookies.

router-bot: deploy started: canary router-config v2026.03.17-rc1 -> 10% traffic (support/stage). monitoring logs for routing_reason changes.

ryan_devx: created issue ENG-5892: "router: ignore blank region cookie; prefer explicit region header if present". added unit + integration tests that exercise cookie/header precedence and blank-value handling. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/4321

ingrid_ops: i'll add an infra metric to detect a sudden rise in blank-region-cookie occurrences (metric: cookie.region.empty.count). set alert to P3 for bursts >100/min across a POP.

mike_support: notified customer of workaround (clear cookies or add query/body region param) and that we're rolling a fix. customer confirmed clearing cookies fixed routing and latency. billing impact: they asked for credit for the multi-hour US egress. i'll open billing ticket.

anya_sre: can we also push a quick doc blurb for partners/CDN integration notes to warn about CDNs that inject empty cookies? small note in docs/devops-integration.

ryan_devx: PR merged to main, canary looks good for 20 mins. rolling to 50% now. change: router treats empty string as absent and header precedence updated.

router-bot: deploy success: v2026.03.17 rolled to 100% (router-config). no regressions detected.

mike_support: confirmed with customer that routing stayed in EU after fix. closing this support thread after billing follow-up. thanks all.

ingrid_ops: billing ticket BTC-893 opened to evaluate egress credit. tagging finance.

mike_support: assigning follow-up: update docs + notify partner-cdn. will close once billing done.
